categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt with absolute sitemap URL
Valid sitemap-index.xml and sitemap-0.xml with 7 URLs
All pages have canonical tags
No trailing slash inconsistency in internal links
HTML lang attribute set to 'en'
HTTPS configured

findings.title: trailingSlash not explicitly configured
findings.description: astro.config.mjs does not set trailingSlash: 'never'. Sitemap and canonical URLs all end with '/' (Astro default). Internal links do not have trailing slashes. Currently consistent but risky if server config differs.
findings.recommendation: Add trailingSlash: 'never' to astro.config.mjs to explicitly control URL format.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: All 7 pages have title (40-60 chars), description (140-160 chars), and H1
Complete OG tags on all pages (title, description, image, url)
Privacy page correctly set to noindex
17 internal links on homepage, 0 with trailing slashes
Clean heading hierarchy: H1(1) → H2(15) → H3(46) on homepage

findings.title: Privacy page title too short (31 chars)
findings.description: Privacy page title is 31 chars (below 40 minimum). However, page is noindex so impact is minimal.
findings.recommendation: No action needed since page is noindex.

findings.title: Blog breadcrumb hardcoded
findings.description: BlogLayout.astro has 'Blog' breadcrumb link hardcoded to /blog/yaml-syntax-guide instead of a dynamic or generic blog index path.
findings.recommendation: Change to accept props or use a generic /blog/ path.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage has substantial content (3528 words)
Tool pages have good content (1500-1700 words)
Privacy policy present
Clear data safety messaging (100% client-side)

findings.title: Blog posts are thin content
findings.description: Three blog posts range from 557-634 words. Recommended minimum is 800-1200 words for competitive ranking.
findings.recommendation: Expand each blog post with additional sections, examples, and practical tips.

findings.title: No About page
findings.description: Site lacks an About page, which weakens E-E-A-T trust signals.
findings.recommendation: Create /about/ page with project background, author info, and technical details.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: Homepage has rich schema: WebApplication, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage (12 Qs), HowTo (3 steps), Organization, BreadcrumbList
Tool pages (json-to-yaml, yaml-to-json) have WebApplication + HowTo + FAQPage

findings.title: Blog pages have no JSON-LD
findings.description: All 3 blog pages lack any structured data (no BlogPosting, Article, or BreadcrumbList schema).
findings.recommendation: Add BlogPosting JSON-LD to BlogLayout.astro with headline, datePublished, author, and description.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Static output mode, no SSR overhead
Reasonable code splitting (3 chunks)
No third-party tracking scripts
Pure client-side processing, no API latency

findings.title: ToolPanel chunk is large (445 kB)
findings.description: The ToolPanel JavaScript chunk is 445 kB (142 kB gzipped). Contains CodeMirror editor and YAML parser.
findings.recommendation: Consider lazy loading the ToolPanel component. Already using client:idle which helps.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Rich FAQPage schema helps AI citation
Clear tool descriptions suitable for AI answers
Consistent brand naming

findings.title: No llms.txt file
findings.description: Site does not provide llms.txt for AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity) to understand site purpose and content scope.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt with site description, content scope, and usage terms.

categories.name: Images
